question: Why are canopy contact and incense fragrance not considered ritually defiled?
premises: Certain things may become ritually defiled
Touch of canopy or garland occurs in worship
Incense fragrance pervades the worship space
inference: Contact with the canopy or garland and the fragrance of incense are not defiled.
plain_english: Contact with the canopy or garland and the fragrance of incense are not defiled.
